title: Voyager Golden Record music selection (Bach 'would just be bragging')

tellings.quote: My favorite story of that was somebody said, "Well, we got to put uh Bach on the record." And somebody said that would just be bragging. [laughter]

plain: Michael Shermer, a writer who questions extraordinary claims, tells a story about the Voyager Golden Record, a disc of sounds and music sent into space on NASA's Voyager probes in 1977 for any alien who might find it, put together by a team around the astronomer Carl Sagan. Shermer says he heard it in an audio book about the record: someone said they had to put Bach on it, and someone else replied that would just be bragging. He tells it as his favourite story about how the team chose what to say about humanity.
